name: pingpong-reboot
description: PING PONG : REBOOT — 레트로 아케이드 게임 플랫폼

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
